non_claims: The aglycone is assigned by the precursor composition hypothesis; isomers of one formula (geniposidic acid vs gardoside; loganic, mussaenosidic and dihydrocornic acids) are not resolved.
Sugar identity and linkage are not claimed.
The CO2 loss is a generic loss and supports the rule without carrying the claim.

notes: Free C4-acid iridoid glucosides lose hexose and then CO2 from the aglycone anion (Fu 2014; Ren 2007), and 3-oxopropanoic acid by ring cleavage (Ren 2007; matching ions in Fu 2014); no paper prints a floor, so the 1 % default applies.

competitors.note: C4 methyl esters share the hexose loss but give the C4H6O3 loss and the C4H5O3- anion instead (Fu 2014 summary rule 4; Ren 2007 Schemes 1-3).

priors.note: C4-carboxylic acid iridoid glucosides gave [M-H]- and [2M-H]- with no formate adduct.
Carboxylic-acid iridoids gave [M-H]- as the quasi-molecular ion.
